title: COVID origins
subtitle: Origin is not settled to KNOWN; market-centred zoonosis is PROBABLE; lab-associated incident remains live; early messaging over-closed
livingFileNotice: This is a Living Evidence File. Science, FOI, and intelligence assessments can still move. The Edition language freeze applies: C1 and C2 are not peer-frozen science, and this file does not treat origin as settled. New discriminating evidence (intermediate host, or lab inventory/matching sequences) enters the private dossier first, then this file with a changelog.

overall.label: Origin unresolved at KNOWN; zoonosis best-supported natural account; lab live; bioweapon unsupported
overall.confidence: Very high that origin is not settled; mixed on which hypothesis wins
overall.summary: Where SARS-CoV-2 first entered humans is not established to KNOWN. The US Intelligence Community’s 2021 declassified assessment judged two hypotheses plausible — natural exposure to an infected animal, and a laboratory-associated incident — and remained divided (four elements plus NIC, low confidence, natural; one element, moderate confidence, laboratory-associated at WIV; three unable to coalesce). Broad IC agreement: the virus was not developed as a biological weapon. Peer-reviewed work (Worobey; Pekar, Science 2022) supports the Huanan market as an early epicentre consistent with zoonotic emergence, including dual introductions; the intermediate-host chain is not closed, so zoonosis is PROBABLE, not KNOWN. A laboratory-associated incident remains a live hypothesis given Wuhan sarbecovirus research context, DEFUSE-class design prior, opacity, and the IC split — POSSIBLE, not established. Early 2020 prestige messaging over-closed laboratory scenarios (Proximal Origin ‘not plausible’; Lancet ‘conspiracy theories’) while later IC product still called both plausible. DEFUSE was a rejected DARPA proposal, not a recipe that produced the pandemic virus. Political team-jersey is not evidence. This file executes the Edition language freeze: no named human virologist has signed the Ministry brief; C1/C2 confidences are not frozen science.

claims.confidence: Moderate–high on market centrality; moderate on pure wildlife-trade origin
claims.claim: A market-centred zoonotic path remains the best-supported natural account. Worobey et al., Science 2022: the Huanan Seafood Wholesale Market was the early epicentre; earliest known December 2019 cases, including those without reported direct market links, were geographically centred on that market; live SARS-CoV-2-susceptible mammals were sold there in late 2019; within-market positive environmental samples associated with live-mammal vendors. Pekar et al., Science 2022: pre-February 2020 genomic diversity is consistent with at least two separate cross-species transmissions (lineages A and B), with first zoonotic transmission of lineage B around 18 November 2019 (interval 23 Oct–8 Dec). Intermediate-host chain is not publicly closed. Market-as-amplifier of a laboratory introduction remains a residual hybrid. This is not KNOWN origin.
claims.why: Best peer-reviewed Z case. Worobey/Pekar are related-programme papers (partial dependence). Intermediate host and data-access limits block KNOWN.

claims.confidence: Moderate as a live hypothesis — not established
claims.claim: A laboratory-associated incident (research-related infection, animal handling, sampling, or accidental release) involving work on related sarbecoviruses in Wuhan remains a live hypothesis. One IC element assessed with moderate confidence that the first human infection most likely was laboratory-associated, probably involving WIV. DEFUSE-class research prior and Chinese investigation-hinder raise the prior. There is no public lab inventory or matching unpublished sequence that establishes this. Geographic co-location of WIV and the outbreak is not enough. Absence of a closed intermediate host raises the cost of pure zoonosis; it does not prove a lab incident. Not KNOWN. Not a culture-war symmetry play: ODNI called both hypotheses plausible.
claims.why: Live science residual, not team jersey. Schema has no POSSIBLE–PROBABLE hyphen; POSSIBLE is the honest object band until inventory/sequence/serology appear.

claims.claim: Present evidence does not establish either natural spillover or a laboratory-associated incident to KNOWN. ODNI 2021: all agencies assess both hypotheses plausible; the IC remains divided on the most likely origin. Four IC elements plus the National Intelligence Council: low confidence, natural exposure most likely. One IC element: moderate confidence, laboratory-associated. Three: unable to coalesce without more information. A more definitive explanation needs new pathway evidence — specific natural contact or lab handling of SARS-CoV-2 or a close progenitor before emergence. One-agency lean is not KNOWN lab origin. ‘Science settled natural origin’ is a forbidden sentence of this file.
claims.why: Meta-finding. IC split plus scientific residual. Language freeze C3.

claims.claim: The claim that SARS-CoV-2 was developed as a biological weapon is UNSUPPORTED as established. ODNI: the IC reached broad agreement the virus was not developed as a biological weapon. Most agencies, low confidence, probably not genetically engineered; two agencies insufficient evidence either way. This is a separate proposition from accidental laboratory-associated infection (C2).
claims.why: IC broad agreement. Do not collapse weaponisation into research-related accident.

claims.claim: Early 2020 scientific messaging overstated certainty against laboratory-associated hypotheses relative to the evidence then. Andersen et al., Nature Medicine, March 2020 (‘The proximal origin of SARS-CoV-2’): ‘Our analyses clearly show that SARS-CoV-2 is not a laboratory construct or a purposefully manipulated virus’; ‘we do not believe that any type of laboratory-based scenario is plausible.’ The same paper notes it is currently impossible to prove or disprove some origin theories while still closing laboratory-based scenarios as implausible — rhetorical over-closure. Calisher et al., Lancet, 19 February 2020: ‘We stand together to strongly condemn conspiracy theories suggesting that COVID-19 does not have a natural origin.’ Peter Daszak / EcoHealth organisational role in that letter process is a conflict-of-independence residual given EcoHealth–WIV links. C5 is process over-closure, not a finding that Proximal Origin committed fraud, and not a finding that ‘not a laboratory construct’ is false.
claims.why: Text pins. FOI trails of February 2020 private lab-feature concern versus public hard closure are supporting process colour, not a fraud verdict.

claims.claim: PRC authorities restricted early outbreak data, sample access, and independent investigation. ODNI: Beijing continues to hinder global investigation and resist sharing; China’s cooperation is most likely needed for a more definitive explanation. Opacity raises residual for both zoonosis and lab hypotheses. It does not alone prove a laboratory incident.
claims.why: IC process finding plus constrained WHO–China joint investigation access. Discriminates against premature closure of either object path.

claims.confidence: High as context; UNSUPPORTED as cause
claims.claim: Research proposals and lab work on bat sarbecoviruses at or near Wuhan are relevant prior context for a laboratory-associated hypothesis and are not proof of release. DEFUSE (2018): EcoHealth Alliance proposal to DARPA PREEMPT, collaborators including WIV context; proposed infectious clones of bat SARS-related coronaviruses and introduction of human-specific proteolytic cleavage sites into spike. DARPA rejected the proposal; it was not funded as written. Proposal ≠ experiment performed ≠ pandemic virus. ‘DEFUSE proves the virus was engineered and released’ is a forbidden sentence of this file.
claims.why: Two-part claim. Context KNOWN; causation UNSUPPORTED. Schema one ledger: object-cause is the load-bearing half for this ID — overall summary splits them. Ledger KNOWN is for the existence of the rejected proposal as context; the claim text forbids causal upgrade.

claims.claim: Platform and institutional framing treated laboratory-associated discussion as fringe or misinformation at times when it remained a live scientific hypothesis and while the IC was still split. This is a process failure of uncertainty communication. Some true nonsense was also moderated. Dated platform exhibits are a polish residual. C8 cannot upgrade C2 to KNOWN.
claims.why: Weaker than C5’s primary texts. Held PROBABLE. Language freeze item 8.

claims.claim: What would discriminate: a closed intermediate-host plus tight wildlife-trade chain would raise C1 toward KNOWN; a verifiable lab inventory, matching unpublished sequences, or documented research-related infections would raise C2 toward KNOWN. No intermediate host is not proof of a lab leak. One IC agency’s moderate lab lean is not KNOWN lab origin. Left/right ownership of either story is not evidence. This file has not completed named human virologist hostile review; C1/C2 confidences are not peer-frozen science.
claims.why: Discrimination table plus language freeze. Team jersey is not a lineage.

timeline.event: DEFUSE proposal to DARPA PREEMPT (EcoHealth–WIV context; cleavage-site insertion class). Rejected, not funded as written.
IC: small-scale exposure probably no later than November 2019; first known cluster Wuhan December 2019. Pekar: lineage B introduction interval includes ~18 Nov 2019.
Lancet Calisher et al.: condemn ‘conspiracy theories’ of non-natural origin.
Proximal Origin (Nat Med): not a laboratory construct; laboratory-based scenario not plausible.
ODNI declassified IC assessment: both hypotheses plausible; IC divided; not a bioweapon.
Worobey and Pekar Science papers: Huanan epicentre; ≥2 introductions.
timeline.effect: C1 best Z case, still not KNOWN

wouldChange: Intermediate host plus tight wildlife chain would force C1 toward KNOWN.
Verifiable lab inventory or matching unpublished sequences would force C2 up and could force C3 down.
A finding that ODNI misstated the IC split would force C3 down.
Proof Proximal Origin’s authors committed fraud (not mere over-closure) would move C5’s process finding, not automatically C1/C2.
Nothing in lockdown or vaccine culture war changes this file’s object question.

methodAudit.name: Grammar
methodAudit.note: Zoonosis, lab-associated accident, bioweapon, unsettled-meta, messaging over-closure, opacity, DEFUSE-context, platform framing, and discrimination method are separate. ‘Lab leak’ in popular speech collapses C2 with C4 and C7.

methodAudit.name: Logic
methodAudit.note: H-zoonosis best natural, not closed. H-lab live, not established. H-weapon rejected. H-settled rejected. H-defuse-recipe rejected. Hidden premises blocked: no host = lab; WIV city = release; one IC lean = KNOWN; Proximal Origin = fraud; DEFUSE = recipe.

methodAudit.name: Rhetoric
methodAudit.note: Forbidden: science settled; lab leak is conspiracy theory as object verdict; DEFUSE proves release; one-agency lean = KNOWN lab. Neutral: both hypotheses live; market papers are the best Z case; early letters over-closed; opacity hurts both.

methodAudit.name: Reality
methodAudit.note: Discriminators: Worobey spatial epicentre; Pekar dual intro; ODNI split and not-bioweapon; Proximal Origin ‘not plausible’; DEFUSE rejected. Controls: intermediate host absent; no inventory gun; Worobey/Pekar related programme.

methodAudit.name: Independence
methodAudit.note: Market Science papers ≠ ODNI. Proximal Origin authors later in market-emergence programme — process for C5, not automatic discount of 2022 spatial epi. DEFUSE is not a third origin lineage.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 1 — Z settled
methodAudit.note: Attack: you are keeping lab alive for symmetry. Response: ODNI both plausible; no intermediate host; C1 still ranks higher (PROBABLE vs POSSIBLE).

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 2 — Market papers gospel
methodAudit.note: Attack: amplifier hypothesis ignored. Response: residual explicit; C1 not KNOWN.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 3 — Proximal Origin smear
methodAudit.note: Attack: process critique is political. Response: ‘not construct’ can be true while ‘no laboratory-based scenario plausible’ over-closes accident/escape. Not a fraud verdict.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 4 — DEFUSE recipe
methodAudit.note: Attack: they wrote the virus. Response: rejected/unfunded. C7.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 5 — FBI/DOE settle it
methodAudit.note: Attack: later agency leans are KNOWN L. Response: this file’s IC pin is the 2021 split product. One-agency lean still not C3 reversal. Living-file refresh if a later assessment changes the split with comparable public text.

methodAudit.name: Hostile Pass 6 — Human PE missing
methodAudit.note: Attack: then don’t publish origin. Response: language freeze executed. File is living; C1/C2 not frozen science; C3 is the load-bearing public sentence.

changelog.change: Evidence File 017 initial publication as a Living File under the Edition language freeze. Origin not settled (C3 KNOWN). Zoonosis PROBABLE; lab-associated POSSIBLE; bioweapon UNSUPPORTED. Proximal Origin/Lancet over-closure and PRC opacity KNOWN process. DEFUSE context not cause. No named human virologist. Author sequential-open after JFK.
